scenes.title: Crown and One Thousand Offerings
scenes.english_text: After King David grew old, young Solomon became the new king of Israel. Solomon loved God deeply and traveled to Gibeon to worship Him. There, he offered one thousand burnt offerings on the altar with a humble and grateful heart.
scenes.tetum_translation: Bainhira Liurai David katuas tiha, labarik-mane Salomão sai liurai foun ba Izraél. Salomão domin Maromak ho laran tomak no ba Gibeón atu adora Nia. Iha ne'ebá, nia sakrifika sakrifiku motu nian rihun ida iha altár leten ho laran-haraik-an no agradese.
scenes.scene_summary: Young Solomon is crowned King of Israel and offers one thousand burnt offerings to worship God at Gibeon.

scenes.title: Asking for Wisdom
scenes.english_text: That night, God appeared to Solomon in a dream and said, 'Ask for whatever you want Me to give you.' Instead of asking for wealth or long life, Solomon humbly asked for a listening heart and wisdom to govern God's people well. God was so pleased with his prayer that He granted him unmatched wisdom, plus riches and honor.
scenes.tetum_translation: Kalan ne'e, Maromak mosu ba Salomão iha mehi laran no dehan, 'Husu buat ne'ebé ó hakarak Ha'u fó ba ó.' Duké husu rikoin ka moris naruk, Salomão husu ho haraik-an laran ne'ebé rona no matenek atu ukun Maromak nia povu ho di'ak. Maromak haksolok tebes ho nia orasaun nune'i fó ba nia matenek boot no mós rikoin ho onra.
scenes.scene_summary: God asks Solomon what he desires in a dream, and Solomon humbly asks for wisdom to lead Israel.

scenes.title: The Wise Judgment
scenes.english_text: Two women came to King Solomon with one living baby, both claiming to be the mother. Solomon wisely called for a sword and suggested cutting the baby in half to share. The true mother immediately cried out, 'Please do not harm him! Give him to her!' Seeing her deep love, Solomon returned the baby safely to his real mother.
scenes.tetum_translation: Feto rua mai iha Liurai Salomão nia oin ho bebé moris ida, no hotu-hotu dehan sira mak bebé nia inan. Salomão ho matenek husu tudik-boot ida no sugere ko'a bebé ne'e ba rua atu fahe. Inan loloos hakilar kedas ho tanis, 'Favour keta estraga nia! Fó nia ba feto ne'e!' Tanba haree nia domin boot, Salomão fó fali bebé ba nia inan loloos.
scenes.scene_summary: King Solomon uses divine wisdom to identify the true mother of a baby, winning the nation's admiration.

scenes.title: Building the Holy Temple
scenes.english_text: Solomon began the great work of building a house for the Lord in Jerusalem. Using fine cedar wood from Lebanon, precious stones, and pure gold, thousands of skilled workers built the Temple over seven glorious years until it shone with magnificent beauty.
scenes.tetum_translation: Salomão hahú servisu boot atu harii uma ba Na'i iha Jeruzalém. Ho keda-ai furak husi Líbano, fatuk folin-boot sira, no osan-mean moos, trebadór matenek rihun ba rihun harii Umaklesan Santu durante tinan hitu ho nakroman furak tebes.
scenes.scene_summary: Solomon builds the splendid Temple of Jerusalem using cedar wood, fine stones, and pure gold.

scenes.title: Dedicating the Temple
scenes.english_text: When the Temple was finished, priests brought the holy Ark of the Covenant into the Most Holy Place. King Solomon spread out his hands toward heaven and prayed a beautiful prayer of dedication. Suddenly, God's glory filled the Temple like a bright, glowing cloud!
scenes.tetum_translation: Bainhira Umaklesan Santu hotu tiha, amululik sira lori Bote Santu ba Fatin Santu Liu. Liurai Salomão laran-luak loke nia liman ba lalehan no harohan orasaun dedikasaun nian ne'ebé furak. Derrepente, Maromak nia glória nakonu iha Umaklesan laran hanesan kalohan naroman sula-lakan!
scenes.scene_summary: King Solomon prays at the Temple dedication, and God's glory fills the building like a glowing cloud.

scenes.title: The Queen of Sheba's Visit
scenes.english_text: Reports of Solomon's extraordinary wisdom and wealth spread across the world. The Queen of Sheba traveled from afar with camels bearing spices and gold to test him with hard questions. Solomon answered every question easily, leaving the Queen amazed by God's great blessing on Israel.
scenes.tetum_translation: Rona kona-ba Salomão nia matenek boot no rikoin naklekar ba raiklaran tomak. Liurai-feto husi Sabá la'o husi dook ho karavanas karradas espesiaria no osan-mean atu koko nia ho husu susar sira. Salomão hatán husu hotu-hotu ho fasil, halo Liurai-feto admira tebes ba Maromak nia bensaun boot iha Izraél.
scenes.scene_summary: The Queen of Sheba visits Solomon with hard questions and is awed by his divine wisdom and wealth.

scenes.title: A Warning Against Idolatry
scenes.english_text: As King Solomon grew older, he made a tragic mistake by marrying many foreign wives who turned his heart away from God. Solomon began building shrines to false idols, breaking God's holy covenant. God warned Solomon that his kingdom would be divided because of his disobedience.
scenes.tetum_translation: Bainhira Liurai Salomão hahú katuas, nia halo sala boot hodi kaben ho feto rai-lür barak ne'ebé halo nia laran hasees husi Maromak. Salomão hahú harii altár ba ida-nook sira, hodi haroot Maromak nia aliansa santu. Maromak fo avisada ba Salomão katak nia reinu sei fahe tanba nia la halo tuir.
scenes.scene_summary: In his later years, Solomon strays into idolatry, and God warns him that his kingdom will be divided.

scenes.title: The Fear of the Lord Is Wisdom
scenes.english_text: At the end of his life, Solomon looked back on all his achievements and recorded his wisdom in Proverbs and Ecclesiastes. He realized that worldly wealth and pleasure are meaningless without God, concluding, 'Fear God and keep His commandments, for this is the duty of all mankind.'
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha nia moris nia rohan, Salomão haree fali ba nia hahalok hotu no hakerek nia matenek iha Provérbios no Eclesiastes. Nia hatene katak rikoin no ksolok raiklaran la iha sentidu se la iha Maromak, no nia dehan ikusmai, 'Respeitu Maromak no tau matan ba Nia Ukun-fuan sira, tanba ne'e mak ema hotu nia dever.'
scenes.scene_summary: Solomon writes Proverbs and Ecclesiastes, concluding that fearing God and obeying Him is true wisdom.

reflection.core_lesson_en: Solomon shows us that true wisdom comes from God and starts with a humble, listening heart that stays faithful to Him.
reflection.core_lesson_tet: Salomão hatudu mai ita katak matenek loloos mai husi Maromak no hahú ho laran-haraik-an ne'ebé rona no laran-metin ba Nia.
reflection.discussion_question_en: When you need to make a wise decision this week, how can you pray to God for wisdom instead of just trusting your own ideas?
reflection.discussion_question_tet: Bainhira ó precisa halo desizaun matenek iha semana ne'e, oinsá ó bele harohan ba Maromak husu matenek duké fiar de'it ba ó-nia hanoin rasik?
